name: Phone Connect
author: Brett
description: Pairs the Phone Connect companion app (phone-connect@1) with this console and sends it work: open a page, show a notification, show an approval prompt, start / stop / ask the audio-output recorder, say a line or listen once. Pairing is a one-time code from Settings → Plugins → Phone Connect claimed on the phone with your own hub sign-in; the phone then holds a device token you can revoke at any time. Approvals shown on the phone are decided only by your own tap there (personOnly): no session, agent, MCP tool, CLI or voice phrase can approve or deny. Every action is reachable four ways: REST /api/plugins/phone-connect/…, MCP phone_connect_*, `axf phone …` and voice (phone.*). Replaces the AmberX app for push, open-url and the recorder.
